parameters.label: Duration of dimming
parameters.help: This parameter specifies the duration ofa full regulation of the light from 0% to 100%. 0: Immediately. 1-127: Durationin seconds (Default is 5 seconds). 128-255: Duration in minutes (minus 127) from 1 –128 minutes, where 128 is 1 minute.

parameters.label: Duration of on/off
parameters.help: This parameter specifies the duration when turning the light on or off. 0: Immediately. (Default). 1-127: Time in seconds. 128-255: Time in minutes (minus 127) from 1 –128 minutes, where 128 is 1 minute.

parameters.help: Specifies the time that a pushbutton must have been activated before it is accepted as “held-down”. Resolution is 0.01 seconds. 1-255: 1–2.55 seconds. Default is 50, which equals to 500 milliseconds (0,5 seconds).
